title: I Left the Sticky on the Mailroom Labeler That Only Jammed for Me

parts.text: I fed a roll at 8:11 a.m. and the labeler chewed only my strip. Dana from sales ran a roll two minutes later and it purred. I was twenty-seven, shipping clerk, standing in a vest that made me look like I owned the jam. I opened the head. My labels were accordioned; Dana's sensor was wiped and mine was not. I left a sticky: CLEAN THE EYE BETWEEN SHIFTS, NOT BETWEEN FAVORITES. Dana laughed, then her next roll jammed because I had actually run the cleaning cycle she had postponed since June. Facilities laminated my sticky. Dana wipes the eye. The labeler finally knows more than one name.

social.video_title: The labeler had a favorite shipping vest — Part 1/1
social.description: Accordion labels, a purr for sales, a June cleaning. The sticky got laminated. Has a machine ever skipped only you?
